C0641.title: Malicious Ordering to Coerce Merchants into Paying Settlement Fees
C0641.summary: In May 2026, CCTV News reported that Chen first applied for "refund only" and, after merchants refused, complained about stores, placed malicious orders and demanded settlement fees. Investigators found that Chen targeted more than 900 e-commerce stores, placed over 2,700 malicious orders, and accumulated more than 10 million yuan in malicious order value, causing over 60,000 yuan in platform service-fee losses. Prosecutors charged him with sabotaging production and business operations, and Jiangyin People's Court sentenced him to one year and six months in prison. The judgment has taken effect.
